motto: Local notes, synced over the network
scegli_nota: Create a new note or select a tab.
rinomina_suggerimento: Double-click or F2 to rename the note; drag to move it (also Ctrl+Shift+arrows)
nota_nel_cestino: This note is in the trash. Restore it to edit it.
tema_descrizione: Applies to the window and to every widget.
rete_codice_aiuto: Press New code, copy the same code to the other devices to connect and tick the box at the top. Notes are transmitted encrypted with this code.
rete_codice_corto: The code must be at least 8 characters long.
solo_dispositivi: Notes are stored only on this device and the connected ones, with no account or external server.
cartella_privata_android: Notes are stored in the app's private storage: use Export backup to get a copy of the files.
importate: Imported {n} notes. Existing notes were kept.
conferma_importa: The notes in the backup will be added to the existing ones. Continue?
percorso_protetto: Choose a file other than Schedario’s internal archive.
aiuto_licenze: Shows the Schedario licence and the licence texts of the libraries and fonts included in the program
info_testo:
Schedario {versione}

Local notes with tabs, floating widgets and encrypted local network sync.
Rust · egui · MIT licence

Working folder: {cartella}

Ctrl/Cmd+N  new note
Ctrl+Alt+N  quick note, from any program
Ctrl/Cmd+F  search
Ctrl/Cmd+S  save now
Ctrl/Cmd+L  checklist item
Ctrl/Cmd+D  open the note as a widget
Ctrl + wheel, Ctrl +/-  text size
F2  rename the selected tab
primo_piano_on: Always on top: on. The widget stays above other windows; click to turn it off
primo_piano_off: Always on top: off. Other windows can cover the widget; click to keep it always above
riduci: Shrinks the widget to its title bar; press again to open it · also double-click the bar
chiudi_widget: Closes this widget: the note stays in Schedario (an empty quick note is discarded)
ridimensiona: Drag this corner to make the widget bigger or smaller
sposta: Drag the bar to move the widget on the desktop; double-click to shrink it to the bar
setup_titolo: Where should the notes be kept?
setup_testo: Each folder holds its own notes and trash, as plain text files. A new folder starts empty.
cartella_in_uso: This folder is already open in another Schedario window.
cartella_mancante: The notes folder {percorso} cannot be reached. If it is on an external drive, connect it and reopen Schedario; otherwise choose another one.
uscita_bloccata: Some changes are not saved yet. Schedario stays open: free some space or export a backup and try again.
rete_conflitti: {n} notes were edited at the same time on {da}: the losing version was saved as a copy
conflitto_avviso: Conflicting copy. This text was edited at the same time on another device and the note “{titolo}” kept the other version. This copy is from {data}. Compare the two versions and keep the correct one.
conferma_elimina: The note “{titolo}” will be deleted permanently, on the connected devices too. This cannot be undone.
conferma_svuota: All the notes in the trash ({n}) will be deleted permanently, on the connected devices too. This cannot be undone.
rete_codice_debole: Weak code: use at least 12 varied characters, or press New code.
avvio_automatico_aiuto: Schedario opens at sign-in and reopens the widgets in their previous position.
colore_nota: Note colour: tints the widget and the tab, and travels to the other devices too
cronologia_vuota: There are no earlier versions yet. Schedario saves one every five minutes of writing and before every change that arrives from another device.
cronologia_aiuto: Earlier versions saved on this device, newest first. Restoring one does not delete the current text: it stays in the history too.
dimensione_testo_aiuto: Also with Ctrl + mouse wheel, or Ctrl + and Ctrl -. Click the percentage to go back to 100%.
scorciatoia_globale_aiuto: From any program, even with Schedario hidden, opens a new note as a widget, ready to type.
scorciatoia_errore: The shortcut is not available: {errore}. Another program may already use it: choose another one with “Change keys”. On Linux with Wayland global keys are not available.
scorciatoia_premi: Press the new key combination, for example Ctrl+Alt+K. Esc to cancel.
scorciatoia_serve_modificatore: Use at least Ctrl or Alt together with a letter, a number, an F key or the space bar.
scorciatoia_tasto_non_valido: The “{tasto}” key cannot be used: choose a letter, a number, a key from F1 to F12 or the space bar.
aiuto_nuova_nota: Creates an empty note and opens it in the editor · Ctrl+N
aiuto_apri_widget: Puts this note on the desktop, in a small window that stays visible · Ctrl+D
aiuto_ricerca: Shows only the notes that contain these words, in the title or the text, and highlights them · Ctrl+F, Esc to clear
aiuto_cancella: Moves the note to the trash. For a few seconds this can be undone from the box at the bottom
aiuto_ripristina: Puts the note back among the tabs, as it was before it was deleted
aiuto_annulla_cestino: Puts the note back right away
aiuto_conflitto_apri: Shows the note that kept the other version, to compare them
aiuto_conflitto_risolto: This copy becomes a normal note and the warning disappears
aiuto_apri_note: Opens this note in Schedario’s main window
aiuto_titolo_widget: Click to write or change the title
aiuto_nota_cestino: Opens the note in the editor, where it can be restored or deleted permanently
cestino_istruzioni: Click a note to read, restore or delete it.
aiuto_elimina_definitivamente: Deletes the note forever, on the connected devices too. Asks for confirmation first
aiuto_svuota_cestino: Deletes every note in the trash forever, on the connected devices too. Asks for confirmation first
aiuto_rete_nome: The name other devices see for this one. Saved on leaving the field
aiuto_rete_codice: The same code on every device to connect: it encrypts notes during transfer. Saved on leaving the field
aiuto_rete_mostra: Shows or hides the letters of the code
aiuto_rete_genera: Creates a strong random code, to copy to the other devices
aiuto_rete_copia: Copies the code to the clipboard, to paste it on the other devices
aiuto_rete_copia_vuoto: First type a code or create a new one
aiuto_rete_attiva: Turns note exchange with devices that have the same code on or off
aiuto_rete_sincronizza: Exchanges notes right now, without waiting for the automatic check every 20 seconds
aiuto_rete_indirizzo: IP address of the other device, for example 192.168.1.20. Only needed if it is not found automatically
aiuto_rete_aggiungi: Adds the address to the list of devices to contact · Enter
aiuto_cambia_cartella: Opens another notes folder. The current one stays as it is on disk
aiuto_esporta_backup: Saves every note in a single JSON file, to keep or to import elsewhere
aiuto_importa_backup: Adds the notes of a backup file. Existing notes are not modified
aiuto_avvio_automatico: Opens Schedario at sign-in and reopens the widgets in their previous position
aiuto_scorciatoia_cambia: Chooses another key combination for the quick note
aiuto_scorciatoia_spenta: Turn the quick note on first
aiuto_informazioni: Version, notes folder and keyboard shortcuts
aiuto_esci: Saves everything and closes Schedario, widgets included
aiuto_cronologia_ripristina: Brings the note back to this version. The current text stays in the history
aiuto_setup_scegli: Chooses where to keep the notes
aiuto_setup_predefinita: Use the Schedario folder inside Documents
aiuto_setup_esci: Closes the program without creating anything
aiuto_chiudi_menu: Shrinks the menu to a thin strip: the text gets the whole width
aiuto_apri_menu: Opens the menu again, with search, trash and settings
aiuto_ricerca_cestino: Shows only the notes in the trash that contain these words, in the title or the text, and highlights them · Esc to clear
aiuto_titolo_nota: The note's title. While it is empty, the tab uses the first line of the text
aiuto_prendi_ordine: Uses on this device the tab order of another connected device. Notes do not change; asks for confirmation first
prendi_ordine_scegli: Choose the device to take the tab order from.
prendi_ordine_conferma: The tab order on this device will be replaced with the one from {da}. Notes do not change.
ordine_non_raggiungibile: {da} did not answer: check that it is on and connected to the same network, then try again.
ordine_versione_precedente: {da} runs an older version of Schedario, which cannot send the tab order. Update Schedario on that device and try again.
aiuto_mcp_attiva: Turns on a small MCP server reachable only from this computer: an assistant such as Claude Code can read and search the notes
mcp_aiuto: Works only with the code below and only from this computer, never from the network. Schedario must be open, even if only in the notification area.
aiuto_mcp_modifiche: The assistant can also create notes, change them, tick items, pin, colour or move them to the trash
mcp_modifiche_no: The assistant can only read and search.
mcp_modifiche_si: Before every change the previous version goes into the history. The assistant can never delete for good, empty the trash or change settings.
mcp_modifiche_spente: Changes are turned off: in Schedario, in the “AI assistant (MCP)” menu, the user must turn on “Allow changes”.
aiuto_mcp_codice: The assistant must present this code; without it the server does not answer
aiuto_mcp_copia: Copies the code to the clipboard
aiuto_mcp_nuovo_codice: Creates a new code: the old one stops working at once and must be updated in the assistant
aiuto_mcp_copia_comando: Copies to the clipboard the line that connects Claude Code to Schedario, with address and code already included
mcp_comando_aiuto: Paste the command once in a terminal; from then on Claude Code sees Schedario in every folder.
mcp_errore: The MCP server could not start on port {porta}: {errore}
aiuto_lista: Turns the line with the cursor into an item to tick, or back into plain text · Ctrl+L
aiuto_fissa: Keeps the note before the others in the tabs, on the other connected devices too
aiuto_togli_fissata: The note is pinned: click to put it back in its place among the tabs
aiuto_cronologia: Shows the note's earlier versions, with date and preview, and allows restoring them
rete_conflitto: 1 note was edited at the same time on {da}: the losing version was saved as a copy
aiuto_tema_sistema: Uses light or dark colours like the system (in Windows: Settings, Personalisation, Colours) and changes along with it
aiuto_tema_sistema@telefono: Uses light or dark colours like the phone (Settings, Display) and changes along with it
aiuto_annulla_testo: Undoes the last change to the text
aiuto_ricerca_precedente: Goes to the previous match in this note (from the first to the last)
aiuto_ricerca_successiva: Goes to the next match in this note (from the last back to the first)
aiuto_panoramica: Shows every note as a large card: tap one to open it
aiuto_chiudi_panoramica: Closes the overview and goes back to the note (also with the Back button)
rete_codice_aiuto@telefono: Press New code, type the same code on the other devices to connect and tick the box at the top. Notes are transmitted encrypted with this code.
info_testo@telefono:
Schedario {versione}

Local notes with tabs and encrypted local network sync.
Rust · egui · MIT licence

Working folder: {cartella}

Touch and hold a button to read what it does.
Touch and hold the text for Cut, Copy and Paste.
Spread or pinch two fingers on the text to change its size.
colore_nota@telefono: Note colour: tints the tab, and travels to the other devices too
dimensione_testo_aiuto@telefono: Also by spreading or pinching two fingers on the text. Tap the percentage to go back to 100%.
aiuto_nuova_nota@telefono: Creates an empty note and opens it
aiuto_ricerca@telefono: Shows only the notes that contain these words, in the title or the text, and highlights them
cestino_istruzioni@telefono: Tap a note to read, restore or delete it.
aiuto_rete_genera@telefono: Creates a strong random code, to type on the other devices
aiuto_rete_aggiungi@telefono: Adds the address to the list of devices to contact
aiuto_chiudi_menu@telefono: Closes the menu and goes back to the note (also with the Back button)
aiuto_apri_menu@telefono: Opens the menu with search, trash and settings
aiuto_lista@telefono: Turns the line with the cursor into an item to tick, or back into plain text
aiuto_togli_fissata@telefono: The note is pinned: tap to put it back in its place among the tabs
aiuto_impostazioni: Appearance, local network, folder and backup
cestino_rilascia: Drop here to move it to the trash
aiuto_apri_cestino: Shows the notes in the trash, to read, restore or delete them
aiuto_cestina_nota: Moves the open note to the trash (Undo is available for a few seconds). A tab can also be dragged onto this button
aiuto_pulsante_lista: While writing, turns the line with the cursor into an item to tick; otherwise adds an item at the end of the note
chiudi_panoramica_giu: Back to the note (also by dragging down)
aiuto_altre_voci: More: Select all, Undo, Redo, List item
aiuto_data_cronologia: Date of the last change. Tap to see earlier versions
aiuto_maniglia_tastiera: Drag down to close the keyboard
aiuto_annulla_eliminazione: Puts the notes just deleted back in the trash
backup_automatico_spiegazione: Notes are kept in the app’s storage and are deleted if the app is uninstalled. The automatic backup keeps an up-to-date copy in a chosen file, for example in Download or Google Drive: with “Import backup” the notes come back even after reinstalling or on another phone.
aiuto_backup_automatico_attiva: Chooses the file to copy the notes to; from then on the file updates itself after every change
aiuto_backup_automatico_cambia: Chooses another file for the automatic backup; the current one stays where it is
aiuto_backup_automatico_disattiva: Stops updating the file; the file already saved stays where it is
backup_automatico_non_riuscito: Automatic backup failed: the file may have been moved or deleted. Choose the file again with “Change file…”.
backup_automatico_attivato: Automatic backup turned on: the file updates itself after every change.
invito_backup_titolo: Keep a copy of the notes
invito_backup_testo:
Notes are saved only on this phone and are deleted if the app is uninstalled.

To keep a copy, turn on the automatic backup to a chosen file, for example in Download or Google Drive, or sync with a computer (Settings → Local network). Both can also be turned on later, from Settings.
conferma_svuota@telefono: All the notes in the trash ({n}) will be deleted permanently, on the connected devices too. After confirming, CANCEL stays available for 10 seconds.
